AnonymousHttpsAcknowledgement.description:
The one named acknowledgement that admits a credential-free HTTPS
source. This is a security-sensitive operator decision, not a boolean
whose meaning can be lost in a rendered configuration.

oneOf.description: The operator reviewed and approved this fixed anonymous source.

Cidr.description: A private network range in `addr/prefix` form, for example 10.0.0.0/8.

CredentialPlacement.description:
Where a shared client secret travels, Evidence's `CredentialPlacement`
spelling.

oneOf.description: A form parameter on the token request.

EndpointBinding.description:
The environment binding of one pack endpoint: its base URL, its
credentials matching the endpoint's declared kind, and the optional TLS
additions (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2).

anonymousHttps.description:
The operator's explicit acknowledgement that a credential-free
source is intentionally served over verified HTTPS. Omission keeps
the credential-free policy closed outside numeric loopback and mTLS.

baseUrl.description:
The upstream origin; a fixed destination the engine never derives
from a response.

credential.description: The credential; its kind must match the endpoint's declared kind.

endpoint.description: The pack endpoint this binding configures.

maximumResponseBytes.description:
A lower response bound than the pack declares, in bytes; absent, the
declared one applies. A value above the declared one is refused when
the deployment loads.

mtlsIdentity.description: The mTLS client identity, combinable with any authentication kind.

tlsTrustProfile.description:
A trust profile under `outboundTls.trustProfiles` whose CA bundle
the endpoint trusts beside the system roots; absent, the endpoint
trusts the system roots alone.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

FileSource.description:
The runtime binding of one `file` source endpoint: the absolute base
directory the read never leaves, the namespace the item keys carry,
and the read behavior of the camel-file port.

directory.description:
The absolute path of the directory the read lists and reads. A
relative path refuses at the reader.

doneFileName.description:
The done-file a candidate must have beside it: a literal name, or
the candidate's own name inside a fixed prefix and suffix
(`$simple{file:name}` or `${file:name}`). Absent, no done-file
check runs.

include.description:
The Ant-style glob a candidate file name must match; absent,
every file is a candidate. A glob carrying a path separator
refuses at the reader: the read is non-recursive.

maxMessagesPerPoll.description:
Camel's `maxMessagesPerPoll`, accepted for Camel parity; absent,
500. One read emits at most one file, so the member bounds
nothing a read does not already bound.

namespace.description: The namespace every item key of this source carries.

readLockCheckIntervalMilliseconds.description:
The `changed` lock's space between its two checks, in
milliseconds (100 to 5000); absent, 1000. Refused beside any read
lock but `changed`.

readLockTimeoutMilliseconds.description:
The `changed` lock's timeout, in milliseconds (1 to 10000, the
pollEnrich step's own timeout ceiling); absent, 10000. Refused
beside any read lock but `changed`.

JobSources.description: The job source bindings, keyed by the pack endpoint each binds.

file.description: The file sources, keyed by endpoint id.

postgres.description: The read-only postgres sources, keyed by endpoint id.

JobStore.description:
The job store block: the item table's single connection reference.
Secret references only, resolved by the job host.

runtimeUrlRef.description: The runtime connection reference of the item table's database.

trustedRootCertificateRef.description:
The root certificate the connection trusts beside the platform
roots; absent, the platform roots alone.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

MtlsIdentity.description:
The mTLS client identity of an endpoint, orthogonal to the
authentication kind (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2). It is
one way a `none` endpoint reaches a non-loopback source. An operator may
instead acknowledge a credential-free HTTPS source on its fixed runtime
binding.

keyRef.description: The client private key secret reference.

OutboundTls.description:
The private certificate authorities endpoints may trust beside the
system roots (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2), in the shape
Evidence ships: a named profile is a process-local PEM file. A CA
bundle is not a secret, so the profile names a file, never a secret
reference.

PostgresSource.description:
The runtime binding of one read-only `postgres` source endpoint: its
own pool, with its own credential and TLS posture.

namespace.description: The namespace every item key of this source carries.

passwordRef.description: The reference the source password resolves from.

tls.description:
The TLS posture of the connection; absent, the system roots with
TLS required.

ReadLock.description: The read lock of one file source.

oneOf.description: No lock: a candidate is read as it stands.

Camel's `changed` lock: the file's length and last-modified time
stable across two checks spaced the check interval apart.

RuntimeCredential.description:
The credential binding of one endpoint in the runtime config
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2): Evidence's
`SourceAuthentication` variant field for field, minus the pack-side
`headerName` and `scheme`. The kind must match the endpoint's declared
kind; the checks refuse a mismatch.

oneOf.description: The static token, presented under the endpoint's declared `scheme`.
The static API key, sent in the endpoint's declared header.

The client-credentials binding, Evidence's fields: the token
endpoint, the client id, and the shared secret, all as references
or fixed strings.

assumedLifetimeSeconds.description: Lifetime assumed when the provider omits `expires_in`.

credentialPlacement.description: Where the shared client secret travels.

maximumCacheSeconds.description: The token cache ceiling, Evidence's bound.

resource.description:
RFC 8707 resource indicator sent as a token-request form
parameter.

tokenEndpoint.description:
The token endpoint, a fixed destination never derived from a
response; an absolute `http`/`https` URL the origin check
confines like any other destination.

oneOf.description:
The private-key-jwt binding, Evidence's fields. The signed
assertion always travels in the form body; there is no placement
parameter.

clientAssertionAudience.description:
Audience claim of the signed assertion, defaulting to the
token endpoint.

clientAssertionKeyRef.description: The private JWK the client assertion is signed with.

tokenEndpoint.description:
The token endpoint, a fixed destination never derived from a
response; an absolute `http`/`https` URL the origin check
confines like any other destination.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

SourceTls.description:
The TLS posture of one postgres source connection. Plaintext is a
test-build posture only and is not part of the format.

oneOf.description: The platform trust roots, TLS required, no client certificate.
One private CA bundle file beside the platform roots.

caBundleFile.description: The absolute path of the PEM file holding the bundle.

TrustProfile.description:
One named private CA bundle: the absolute path of the process-local PEM
file the runtime reads.

caBundleFile.description: The absolute path of the PEM file holding the bundle's certificates.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

description:
The ingestion job's runtime configuration: the endpoint bindings
every mode shares, the job source bindings, and the job store. It
states none of the facade's members (`listener`, `database`, `oidc`,
`allowedClients`, `audit`, `idempotency`, the cursor custody).

allowedPrivateCidrs.description:
The private ranges egress may reach, at least one and at most the
platform bound (CFG-EMPTY-2).

outboundTls.description:
The private CAs endpoints may trust beside the system roots;
absent, every endpoint trusts the system roots alone.

sources.description:
The governed-ingestion source bindings. Absent, the deployment
binds no job source; a pack whose source route reads one refuses
at the job compile, never at the first read.

store.description:
The job store: the item table's database. Read by the job host,
not by the job compile; absent, the document configures no job
store and the host refuses to run a pass.

title: Registry Adapter ingestion job runtime configuration
